title: 第182章 入狱
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顾屿和李沐晴已经收起了遮挡视线的窗帘。

和避免其他玩家看到李沐晴相比，他们两人此时更需要的是视野。

小货车也比进副本前更破了，车身上布满抓痕，甚至李沐晴旁边的车窗都被抓破了。

细碎的玻璃渣子铺满李沐晴的座椅，哪怕被玻璃碴子划伤，她愣是强忍着不吭声。

因为她不想屿哥分心照顾自己。

顾屿瞄了一眼李沐晴逐渐被血液浸湿的黑色短裤，他握着方向盘的手抓得更紧。

可现在根本没有时间给沐晴包扎，四周全是伺机而动的C级猎人，只能先通关副本再处理。

况且，后视镜里的小轿车正逐渐逼近，小轿车里还探出三名握着武器的囚徒。

顾屿微微皱眉，他并不希望这群坐过牢的人追上来，指不定他们为了躲避身后追击的猎人，会做出什么事来。

顾屿刚想问李沐晴后面那群囚徒有什么天赋，自己好有应对的方案。

可他还没开口，李沐晴就摇了摇头，语气明显带着庆幸：

“屿哥，那群人没有天赋。”

“屿哥！左边9点钟！”

随着一声嘶吼响起，顾屿直接选择相信沐晴，他立马往右打了方向，刚好躲过扑击而来的猎人。

可他看着小货车只剩下26的耐久度，眉头拧起，心中不免有些担心。

虽然载具的耐久度可以修复，但修复一级载具需要5枚求生币。

现在顾屿只有23枚求生币。

他还想着攒到30给升到2级载具。

这样小货车速度来到20km/h后，就不用担心身后的尸潮了。

而且速度提高了，晚上也会安全很多。

说不定升到2级后，还能给沐晴搞一张安稳的小床。

可现在，顾屿看着不断减少的耐久度，估计开到终点前，小货车要修复一两次。

这样一来，离给沐晴一张床的愿望，就又远了...

“屿哥，我没事的，先活下来，我们一起慢慢重新攒，死了，就什么都没了...”

李沐晴察觉到了顾屿皱起的皱眉和眼里的不舍，一眼就看穿了顾屿的心思。

李沐晴强忍着大腿的刺痛，边留意四周的草丛，边笑着安慰起来：

“屿哥，我们不一直都这样吗？”

“每当好不容易攒下点钱，总有些事不得不花出去。”

“不是阿姨生病了，就是你送外卖的手机摔坏了。”

“还有一次是我的轮椅坏了...”

“可我们每次不都把钱重新攒起来了吗？虽然...刚攒好就穿越了...”

顾屿听到沐晴的话后，点了点头，深呼吸一口气后，眼神变得极其认真！

为了能与后边的小轿车拉开距离，为了能活下来！

顾屿直接不躲避大部分猎人的扑击。

他选择撞上去！

除非有猎人从侧面扑过来，可能会扒拉着小货车，他这才会选择躲避。

为了速度，能撞的他就直接撞了！

‘嘭——！’

‘嘭——！’

一头头扑过来的猎人被小货车撞开。

有的被小货车撞开，落地后刚摇摇头准备站起来，却看到小货车直接毫不减速地碾了过来！

‘扑哧——！’

这头C级猎人直接被碾成两半。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Gu Yu and Li Muqing had already closed the curtains that blocked their view.

Compared with preventing other players from seeing Li Muqing, what the two of them need now is vision.

The minivan was even worse than before entering the dungeon. The body of the truck was covered with scratches, and even the window next to Li Muqing was scratched.

Li Muqing's seat was covered with tiny pieces of broken glass. Even if she was scratched by the broken glass, she still managed to remain silent.

Because she didn't want Brother Yu to be distracted from taking care of herself.

Gu Yu glanced at Li Muqing's black shorts, which were gradually soaked with blood, and his hand on the steering wheel tightened.

But there was no time to bandage Mu Qing now. There were C-level hunters all around, so he had to clear the dungeon first and then deal with it.

Moreover, the car in the rearview mirror was gradually approaching, and three prisoners holding weapons peeked out of the car.

Gu Yu frowned slightly. He didn't want these people who had been in prison to catch up. He was not sure what they would do to avoid the hunters chasing behind them.

Gu Yu just wanted to ask Li Muqing what talents the prisoners behind him had so that he could have a plan to deal with them.

But before he opened his mouth, Li Muqing shook her head, her tone obviously filled with joy:

"Brother Yu, those people have no talent."

"Brother Yu! It's 9 o'clock on the left!"

As a roar sounded, Gu Yu directly chose to believe Mu Qing. He immediately turned to the right, just in time to avoid the attacking hunter.

But when he saw that the minivan only had 26 durability left, he frowned and felt a little worried.

Although the durability of the vehicle can be repaired, 5 survival coins are required to repair a first-level vehicle.

Now Gu Yu only has 23 survival coins.

He also wants to save up to 30 to upgrade to a level 2 vehicle.

In this way, when the speed of the small truck reaches 20km/h, there is no need to worry about the tide of corpses behind it.

And with the increased speed, it will be much safer at night.

Maybe after she reaches level 2, she can even get a small, stable bed for Mu Qing.

But now, Gu Yu looked at the decreasing durability and estimated that the minivan would need to be repaired once or twice before reaching the end.

In this way, the desire to give Mu Qing a bed is further away...

"Brother Yu, I'm fine. Survive first, and let's slowly rebuild together. If you die, there will be nothing..."

Li Muqing noticed Gu Yu's frown and the reluctance in his eyes, and could see through Gu Yu's thoughts at a glance.

Li Muqing endured the stinging pain in her thigh, paying attention to the grass around her, and comforted her with a smile:

"Brother Yu, haven't we always been like this?"

“Whenever I finally save some money, there are always things I have to spend on.”

"Either Auntie is sick, or the mobile phone you used to deliver food broke."

"Another time my wheelchair broke..."

"But don't we save the money again every time? Although... we traveled through time as soon as we saved it..."

After Gu Yu heard Mu Qing's words, he nodded. After taking a deep breath, his eyes became extremely serious!

In order to keep distance from the car behind, in order to survive!

Gu Yu did not avoid the attacks of most hunters.

He chose to hit it!

Unless a hunter pounces from the side and pulls the small truck, he will choose to avoid it.

For the sake of speed, he just hit whatever he could!

‘Bang——!’

‘Bang——!’

The hunter who rushed towards him was hit by the pickup truck.

Some were hit by a pickup truck. After landing, they shook their heads and prepared to stand up, only to see the pickup truck run over them without slowing down!

‘Puch—!’

This C-level hunter was directly crushed in half.
